```{python}
#| tags: [parameters]
city = "Abilene"
```

```{python}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
import pandas as pd
from plotnine import ggplot, aes, geom_boxplot, geom_line
from IPython.display import display, Markdown
from plotnine.data import txhousing
```

<!--portion: print -->

```{python}
city
```


<!--portion: subset --> 

## Houston is getting pricier

```{python}
select_city = txhousing[txhousing['city'] == "Houston"]
```

```{python}
ggplot.show(
  ggplot(select_city)
 + aes(x="year", y="median", group="year")
 + geom_boxplot(fill="cadetblue")
)
```


<!--portion: recap --> 

```{python}
display(Markdown(f"""
## Median sale prices across Texas (red = {city})
"""))
```

```{python}
# replace 2014 with a parameter
select_year = txhousing[txhousing['year'] == 2014]
```

```{python}
ggplot.show(
  ggplot(select_year)
 + aes(x="month", y="median", group="city")
 + geom_line(color="gray")
 + geom_line(data=select_year[select_year['city'] == "Abilene"], color="red")
)
```
